from textkit.core import line_count, run

# Test cases
tests = [
    ('', 0),           # empty string -> 0
    ('a\nb\n', 2),     # trailing newline -> 2
    ('a\nb', 2),       # no trailing newline -> 2
    ('a\nb\nc\n', 3),  # multiple trailing newlines -> 3
    ('hello world\n', 1),  # single line with newline -> 1
    ('hello', 1),      # single line without newline -> 1
    ('\n', 0),         # just newline (empty lines don't count)
]

for text, expected in tests:
    result = line_count(text)
    status = '✓' if result == expected else '✗'
    print(f'{status} line_count({repr(text)}) = {result} (expected {expected})')

# Test CLI registration
print()
print(f'run(\"lines\", \"a\nb\n\") = {run(\"lines\", \"a\\nb\\n\")}')
